title: Color Swatches
description: A product picker with color swatch RadioCard items named by aria-label and a group label that shows the picked color, plus a RadioCardGrid of sizes. The sold-out size is disabled, struck through, and explained by a Tooltip and a hidden RadioCardDescription, while the group keeps one Tab stop. Use it for options shown as swatches instead of text, or to explain an unavailable option on hover.
